name: IncrediChat – AI Chat Widget
author: bareli

sections.description:
IncrediChat brings AI-powered customer engagement to your WordPress site. Install the plugin, enter your API Key and Widget ID, and start engaging visitors instantly.

Features:

  • AI-powered responses trained on your business knowledge
  • Voice and text chat support
  • Hebrew and RTL language support
  • Mobile optimized responsive design
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Easy setup in under a minute

How It Works:

  1. Sign up at incredichat.com
  2. Get your API Key and Widget ID from the dashboard
  3. Install this plugin and enter your credentials
  4. Done! The chat widget appears on your site

Why IncrediChat?

  • 24/7 automated customer support
  • Reduce support ticket volume
  • Increase customer engagement
  • Multi-language support including Hebrew

Privacy Policy

IncrediChat processes chat conversations to provide AI-powered responses. For details on data handling, please visit incredichat.com/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the incredichat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > IncrediChat
  4. Enter your API Key from your IncrediChat dashboard (starts with “cai_”)
  5. Enter your Widget ID from your IncrediChat dashboard (GUID format)
  6. Save settings
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API Key and Widget ID?

Sign up at incredichat.com and find both in your dashboard under Widget Settings. The API Key starts with “cai_” and the Widget ID is in GUID format (e.g., a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890).

Is there a free plan?

Yes, IncrediChat offers a free trial to get you started.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, IncrediChat is fully compatible with WooCommerce stores.

Does it support Hebrew and RTL languages?

Yes, IncrediChat has full Hebrew and right-to-left language support.

How do I customize the widget appearance?

All customization options are available in your IncrediChat dashboard at my.incredichat.com. Changes apply automatically to your site.

Will this slow down my site?

No, the widget loads asynchronously and does not affect your page load speed.
